description.p: ZamAudio is a set of LADSPA/LV2/VST/VST3/CLAP audio plugins:

ul.li: ZaMaximX2: brickwall limiter
ZamAutoSat: automatic saturation
ZamComp and ZamCompX2: compressor, mono and stero
ZamEQ2: 2 bands parametric equalizer
ZamGEQ31: 31 band graphic equalizer
ZamHeadX2: HRTF acoustic filtering
(NEW in 4.3) ZamNoise: noise reduction based on Gnome Wave Cleaner
ZamPhono: phono filters for restoring vinyl
ZamGate and ZamGateX2: gate mono and stereo
ZamTube: distortion effect modeled after tone stacks from guitar amplifiers
ZamDelay: feedback delay unit
ZamDynamicEQ: dynamic equalizer
ZaMultiComp and ZaMultiCompX2: multiband compressor, mono and stereo
ZamSynth: experimental synthesizer
New plugin: ZamNoise noise reduction based on Gnome Wave Cleaner, uses Ephriam / Malah noise suppression algorithm from 1984
Tweak defaults and ranges on ZamEQ2
Make ZaMaximX2 threshold/gain controls more usable
ZamTube: Introduced both sides of 12AX7 valve emulation with tonestack sandwiched between the valves.
ZamHeadX2: Fixed bug with wrong array dimensions.
Fix VST2 param bug and other improvements.
